summary.text: Says Merkley would end political corruption by banning stock trading and reforming the Supreme Court with a binding code of ethics.
summary.quote: End political corruption: No more stock trading; no more exchanging government favors for investments in Trump’s companies. The Supreme Court needs reform and a binding code of ethics.

summary.text: Says Merkley would strengthen family foundations through housing, healthcare, education, and banning hedge funds from buying single-family homes.
summary.quote: Strengthen the foundations for families to thrive: Housing. Health care. Education. Good-paying jobs! Stop drug companies from price gouging. Ban hedge funds from buying single-family homes.

summary.text: Says Merkley would address climate change by transitioning from fossil fuels to renewables.
summary.quote: Meet the climate chaos challenge: Rapidly transition from dirty, expensive fossils to cheaper, cleaner, renewables.
